lines: [game announcer] New game! Earn one billion dollars... at minimum wage.
[excited] Seven dollars and twenty-five cents an hour. Let's go!
[fast] One day: fifty-eight bucks. One year: fifteen thousand.
[confident] Work your whole life. Forty-five years. Six hundred seventy-eight thousand!
[nervous] That's... not even a tenth of one percent of a billion.
[shocked] You'd need sixty-six thousand years. Full time. No vacations.
[deadpan] Stonehenge is only about five thousand years old. You'd have to clock in before humans invented farming.
[sneaky] So how does anyone get a billion? Not by trading hours for dollars...
[whisper] ...so, new game. Earn one billion dollars... at minimum wage.
